title: Ta-Da!
blurb: Fanfare, in the tradition of the little Windows chime that once announced everything from a successful install to nothing whatsoever. The magic of a ta-da is that merit never enters into it. The sound crowns a genuine accomplishment and a complete nothing presented with showmanship in identical terms. Cleaning exactly one dish. Arriving on time. Finishing the task that was due last Thursday. All the comedy lives in the gap between the size of the fanfare and the size of the achievement.
origin: The classic reveal fanfare, in the tradition of the Windows 3.1 'tada' chime.
